name: Cherise
source:
A true vampire fanatic. She is obsessive, cheerful and determined. She's honest and kind, but can be a little blunt at times. She smiles a lot and usually draws people in with her cheery personality. Her life goal is to one day prove the existence of vampires.

[From [url=https://kagiprojects.tumblr.com/post/159043384319/genjitsukai-the-characters-previews]Kagi Projects[/url]]
